title: Snap Perspective
description: Adds keybinds for switching temporaliy to another perspective
body:
# Snap Perspective
Adds keybinds for switching temporaliy to another perspective.

Holding down the configured key will switch to the perspective until the key is
released.

The mod supports switching between:
- Third Person Back <-> First Person (Bound to "I")
- Third Person Front <-> First Person (Not bound by default)

Inspired by [Camera Keybinds](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/camerakeybinds) and [Perspective Camera Keybinds ](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/perspectivecamerakeybinds)
